functional_requirements.source: Error Handling for Real-Time Updates feature
acceptance_criteria: Users receive clear error messages when updates fail.
The system logs errors for further investigation and analysis.

performance: The system should handle up to 1000 concurrent users without performance degradation.
Real-time updates should occur within 2 seconds of the event.
security: All user data must be encrypted both in transit and at rest.
Implement rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks on login.
scalability: The system should be able to scale horizontally to accommodate increased user load.
The database should support sharding for handling large datasets.
usability: The dashboard should be intuitive and easy to navigate for users of all technical levels.
Provide tooltips and comprehensive help documentation for all features.
reliability: The system should maintain an uptime of 99.9%.
Implement automatic backups of the database every 24 hours.

constraints: The application must comply with GDPR regulations regarding user data.
There is a limited budget for third-party services and tools.
success_criteria: At least 80% of users can complete the task creation process without assistance.
Achieve a user satisfaction rating of 4.5 or higher on a 5-point scale after usage.

risks.risk: Potential data breaches due to inadequate security measures.
risks.mitigation: Implement robust encryption and conduct regular security audits.

risks.risk: User dissatisfaction due to a complex interface.
risks.mitigation: Conduct user testing and iterate on the design based on user feedback.

assumptions: Users will have access to a stable internet connection.
Users will have basic familiarity with web applications.
dependencies: Dependency on a third-party authentication service for user login.
Dependency on a real-time messaging service for task updates.
